mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lf.AttributeName) AS attributeApproxOK, lf.AttributeName, COALESCE(ddc.CodeValue, '') as AttributeTypeName, lf.AttributeLength as AttributeWidth, lf.AttributePrecision FROM sdms_layerfield lf LEFT JOIN sdms_dictdatacode ddc ON lf.AttributeType = ddc.Id AND ddc.DataTypeID = '73160096-67a5-11e7-8eb2-005056bb1c7e' WHERE lf.LayerID = #{layerId};
